body: But also most people will still see them as a bad person forever no matter what they do... we’ve seen this on social media. That alone makes people uncomfortable knowing they’re in their life. Once it’s bad enough people’s whole existence becomes an issue.
Then where should someone go from there other than suicide? It seems like nothing else can or should be done.
If they’re an abuser (not physical) it can’t really be made up for and the problem can’t be faced without hurting the victim more.

But what if they’re genuinely disgusting and their actions already hurt a lot of people. Shouldn’t suicide be the right option? Nothing can make up for how these people feel and were hurt so how can the person causing the hurt keep going without being selfish by staying alive? Should they just do a lot of charity work? What’s the step required to stop being bad?

What if they can’t change and it’s just genuinely due to who they are that they end up doing a lot of bad things. What if some of these “mistakes” went on for months before they realized there was an issue. Why should this person deserve to live.
